MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The powered USB hub feels like a useful next addition because my keyboard, card reader, and other computer accessories create a practical need for more connections.",
    "The wired earbuds connect with my previous headphone purchases, although that interest does not mean I need another pair right now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and Fire TV devices do not address the computer connectivity, maintenance, and organization needs reflected in my recent purchases.",
    "The tablet does not fill a clear gap when I already have a Kindle, and the camera would serve a monitoring need I have not expressed.",
    "The Wi-Fi extender relates broadly to networking, but my Ethernet adapter and cables point toward wired connections rather than a Wi-Fi coverage problem."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics seems to have been treated as a reason to suggest other electronics, even when they serve very different purposes.",
    "My Amazon Basics accessories and Kindle seem to have been taken as interest in Amazon devices generally, including several streaming devices and smart speakers."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchases fit a practical computer setup: wired networking, carrying equipment, storing headphones, and cleaning hardware. Useful additions should connect to those tasks.",
    "An accessory that complements equipment I own is more useful right now than another device that repeats a need my existing equipment already covers.",
    "My frequent purchases do not mean I currently need every kind of electronic device; the specific problem an item solves matters."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my interest in electronics but mostly miss my current focus on practical computer setup improvements."
}
